album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on E in Referring to Jamedaran. The line peaks at E4 (335.9 Hz) at 0:07.4. It closes on A3, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → D4 → A3).
